abstract: We assessed autologous bone marrow (BM) harvest and hematologic recovery after high-dose chemotherapy (HDCT) in patients who failed to achieve peripheral blood stem cell (PBSC) mobilization. One hundred and ninety-three patients with germ cell tumor, malignant lymphoma, sarcoma or medulloblastoma were scheduled for HDCT. In 123 patients, PBSC were mobilized by disease-specific chemotherapy plus granulocyte colony-stimulating factor (G-CSF). In 110/ 123 patients (89%) with circulating CD34+ cell counts 2 > or = 10/microl, sufficient hematopoietic autografts were collected (group A). In 13/123 patients (11%) with peripheral CD34 + cell counts < 10/microl, PBSC harvesting was not performed (group B). These latter patients were classified as "poor mobilizers" and underwent second-line BM harvest at a median of 46 (range 10-99) days after mobilization failure. Seventy patients with first-line BM harvest (group C) acted as historical controls. Ten patients from group B proceeded to HDCT and nine were evaluable for hematopoietic reconstitution. Recovery to neutrophils >0.5 x 10(9)/l was comparable with group C patients: 16 (range 9-34) days vs 13 (range 8-98) days. However, platelet (PLT) reconstitution >20 x 10(9)/l was significantly slower, with a median of 35 (range 13-50) days as compared with 19 (range 9-148) days (P = 0.0106) for control patients. Supportive care requirements, febrile days and length of hospital stay were not significantly different between the two groups of patients. We conclude that patients who fail to mobilize PBSC should be evaluated for second-line BM harvest. This approach may preserve the therapeutic option of HDCT for these patients.
abstract_ja: 末梢血幹細胞（PBSC）動員に失敗した患者における自家骨髄採取と造血回復の評価を行った。胚細胞腫瘍、悪性リンパ腫、肉腫、髄芽腫の患者193例が大量化学療法（HDCT）を予定された。123例では疾患特異的化学療法と顆粒球コロニー刺激因子（G-CSF）によりPBSCを動員した。循環CD34+細胞数が10/μL以上であった110例（89%）では十分な造血幹細胞移植片が採取された（A群）。末梢血CD34+細胞数が10/μL未満の13例（11%）ではPBSC採取は行わず（B群）、これらの患者は「動員不良」と分類され、動員失敗後中央値46日（範囲10～99日）に二次的骨髄採取を受けた。初回骨髄採取を受けた70例を対照（C群）とした。B群のうち10例がHDCTに進み、9例で造血再構築を評価できた。好中球0.5×10⁹/L以上への回復は、C群と同程度であった（16日［範囲9～34］対13日［範囲8～98］）。しかし血小板20×10⁹/L以上への回復は有意に遅く、中央値35日（範囲13～50）対19日（範囲9～148）であった（P=0.0106）。支持療法の必要性、発熱日数、入院期間は両群で有意差はなかった。PBSCの動員に失敗した患者には二次的骨髄採取の適応を評価すべきであり、この方法により、これらの患者に対する大量化学療法という治療選択肢を温存できる可能性がある。
